text: I withdraw this problem vote after the [reply](https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-reviewed-by-test/issues/161). The [definition](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Algebra/DirectSum/Basic.lean#L409) is the intended summation homomorphism: a finite family is sent to the sum of its entries in the ambient monoid. Injectivity is not asserted by its type; `IsInternal` separately requires this map to be bijective. The docstring’s loose “embedding” wording does not justify a mathematical problem verdict. The example in my original note explains possible noninjectivity, not a failure of the construction.
